card.name: Inside drug names; 'with' before disease
card.fires_on: Partway through certain drug and name pieces like AR<<AN>>OTE, A<<uran>>ofin and an<< alan>>ine. Also on 'with' after 'patients' or 'persons' before a serious condition such as severe heart failure.

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: Middle pieces of drug or trial names such as auranofin, ARANOTE and alanine.

modes.label: With before a condition
modes.description: The word 'with' after 'patients' or 'persons' ahead of a serious disease in a caution sentence.
modes.example: If flurbiprofen is used in patients<< with>> severe heart failure, monitor patients for signs

card.plain: It fires in the middle of some drug names and on 'with' in cautions about patients who have severe heart failure or similar conditions.
